scripts.electron:copy-assets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const root = path.resolve(__dirname); const src = path.join(root, 'electron', 'assets'); const dest = path.join(root, 'electron', 'dist', 'assets'); fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true });"
scripts.electron:prep: npm run compile:electron && npm run electron:copy-assets
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "make start-backend" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --port 3004 --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3004 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3004 npm run electron:run"
